high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "stevejobs.quotes." The post features a black-and-white photograph of Steve Jobs, who appears to be deep in thought with his hands clasped together. The quote displayed on the post reads, "Let's go invent tomorrow rather than worrying about what happened yesterday." The post has received 811 likes and was shared 5 days ago. Below the main content, there is a sponsored advertisement for Adobe Photoshop, offering a 60% discount.
